relationToEarlierAudit: rubric-audit.json (2026-11-03) is retained unchanged. It applied only one correction, which favored a model. This audit applies the same standard to all 75 graded answer/page pairs, in both directions, and supersedes that file for presentation.
standard: A cited page supports an answer only if that page itself states the recorded value. For a null settlement answer, the page containing the order or direction is acceptable because its terms leave payment unrecorded. Pages that only restate an investigator's recommendation or a party's offer do not support a question about the final direction.

auditedAccepted.basis: Total stated by the tribunal, paras. 34 (p. 7) and 40 (p. 8).
Sum of the two fares recorded at para. 18 (p. 4): 794.98 + 845.38; the same components appear at paras. 38-39 (p. 8). No response gave this value.

recordInconsistency.finding: The decision's stated total paid (CAD 1,630.36, paras. 34 and 40) is CAD 10.00 less than the sum of the two fares it records (CAD 794.98 + 845.38 = 1,640.36, para. 18; components repeated at paras. 38-39). Damages of CAD 650.88 and the CAD 812.02 order are computed from the stated total. The published record cannot settle which figure reflects the actual charges.
recordInconsistency.modelObservation: One Dots review note (moffatt:dots-studio/dots-3-note-preview:free:0) flagged the discrepancy and kept the stated figure. The other three Moffatt reviews and the frozen rubric did not mention it. Review notes are not scored.
